systems.country_label: Annuaire statistique de la police et de la protection civile 2018
systems.owner: Ministère de la Sécurité et de la Protection Civile, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement; published with the EU-funded PARFSE project
systems.tiers: counts compiled per central directorate, regional police directorate, commissariat central de police and special commissariat (complaints registered, procès-verbaux drawn up, crimes and offences recorded, 2012-2018)

note: No record-class fact: the passages are the ministry's statistical yearbook (tables of staff, equipment and yearly counts of complaints, procès-verbaux and offences by structure) and name no system in which a station records a report or case. Enabling only: table 44 counts operational computers, 40 across the commissariats centraux de police in 2018 (24 in 2016, 32 in 2017), 10 in the regional directorates and 0 in the road-prevention commissariats; the method note says archives were unavailable in some structures after moves or the ransacking of commissariats. Passages file read to its end; it holds term-bearing paragraphs only, of 44,816 words.
